# k0rdent_cluster_type (Data Source)

One ClusterType, including its node pools.

The catalog list does not carry node pools, and pool ids are what a cluster's `node_pool` map is keyed by, so this is the data source that tells you which pools exist, what they are for, and what node counts they accept.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "k0rdent_cluster_type" "gpu" {
  id = "gpu-training"
}

# Pass self_link to a cluster to bind it to this type.
output "kubernetes_version" {
  value = data.k0rdent_cluster_type.gpu.kubernetes_version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The ClusterType's id, its slug in the region's catalog. **Constraints:** Must be lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter and not ending with a hyphen (`[a-z]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?`), because it becomes a segment of a request URL.

### Optional

- `region` (String) Region to read. Defaults to the provider's `region`. **Constraints:** Must be lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter and not ending with a hyphen (`[a-z]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?`), because it becomes a segment of a request URL.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Free-form text describing it, for people to read, when one was set.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name, for display only.
- `kubernetes_version` (String) The k0s version clusters of this type are provisioned with, as `vX.Y.Z` or `vX.Y.Z+k0s.N`. Null for a ClusterType that is not Kubernetes-flavoured. There is no catalogue of supported versions, this is the version this type gives you.
- `node_pools` (Attributes List) Node pools defined at the current version. Sorted by `id`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--node_pools))
- `self_link` (String) Reference to this ClusterType, for a cluster's `cluster_type`. Head-scoped: it binds whatever the current version is at create time.
- `status` (String) Lifecycle status of the current version.
- `version` (Number) Sequential version number of the current version, for display.

<a id="nestedatt--node_pools"></a>
### Nested Schema for `node_pools`

Read-Only:

- `display_name` (String) Optional display name.
- `id` (String) Pool slug. This is the key a cluster's or instance group's `node_pool` map uses.
- `machine_type` (String) Reference to the MachineType backing this pool. **Known gap.** A name only. A tenant can't read what hardware or image it is. The [hardcoded values](../guides/hardcoded-values.md) guide names the side that has to change.
- `node_count_default` (Number) Count used when a cluster does not override this pool. Null means a cluster must supply one.
- `node_count_max` (Number) Highest count this pool accepts. Null means unbounded.
- `node_count_min` (Number) Lowest count this pool accepts. Null means no floor above zero.
- `role` (String) `control-plane` or `worker`. Control-plane pools can't be scaled.
